sn29.5:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
sn29.5:1.3: ‘‘ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacce saṃsedajā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī’’ti?
sn29.5:1.5: ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacce saṃsedajā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantī’’ti.
